title: Remaining HTML features that ship in at least one engine
criteria: From the 2026-10-09 gap report: standards-track, not deprecated, shipping in at least one engine, and missing from VS Code's built-in data.

values.name: any
values.description: Close requests (such as Esc) and clicks outside the dialog (light dismiss) both close it.

values.name: closerequest
values.description: Only close requests (such as Esc) close the dialog.

values.name: none
values.description: No user action closes the dialog automatically.

values.name: render
values.description: Hold off rendering the page until this resource has loaded.

values.name: limited-srgb
values.description: 8-bit sRGB colors such as `#123456`. This is the default.

values.name: display-p3
values.description: Colors in the Display P3 space, such as `color(display-p3 1 0.2 0.1)`.

values.name: named
values.description: Children are assigned to slots by their `slot` attribute. This is the default.

values.name: manual
values.description: Slot assignment is done by script with `HTMLSlotElement.assign()`.

values.name: none
values.description: User input doesn't move the model. This is the default.

attributes.name: webkitdirectory
attributes.description: For `type="file"`, lets the user choose a directory instead of individual files; every file inside it, including subdirectories, is selected. Defined by the File and Directory Entries API, not the HTML Standard.

attributes.name: alpha
attributes.description: For `type="color"`, lets the user pick a color with transparency instead of only fully opaque colors.

attributes.name: colorspace
attributes.description: For `type="color"`, the color space of the value, which also hints at the picker to show. `limited-srgb` (the default) gives 8-bit sRGB colors; `display-p3` gives `color(display-p3 …)` values.

attributes.name: closedby
attributes.description: Which user actions close the dialog. `any`: close requests (such as Esc) and clicks outside the dialog. `closerequest`: close requests only. `none`: neither. When omitted, modal dialogs behave like `closerequest` and non-modal dialogs like `none`.

attributes.name: blocking
attributes.description: Operations to block until this resource has loaded, as a space-separated list. The only token is `render`, which keeps the page from rendering until the style sheet or preloaded resource arrives.

attributes.name: blocking
attributes.description: Operations to block until this external script has loaded, as a space-separated list. The only token is `render`, which keeps the page from rendering until then (useful with `async` scripts).

attributes.name: blocking
attributes.description: Operations to block until this style sheet and its imports have loaded, as a space-separated list. The only token is `render`.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: Names the `<?marker>` or `<?start>` processing instruction where this template's content is inserted, or the start of the range it replaces, for declarative partial updates. The value must match that instruction's `name`.

attributes.name: shadowrootslotassignment
attributes.description: Slot assignment mode for the declarative shadow root: `named` (the default) assigns children by their `slot` attribute; `manual` leaves assignment to script.

attributes.name: shadowrootcustomelementregistry
attributes.description: Creates the declarative shadow root without a custom element registry, so that a scoped `CustomElementRegistry` can be attached to it later with `initialize()`.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: `lazy` defers fetching the media until the element nears the viewport; it takes precedence over `preload`, and with `autoplay` it also delays playback. `eager` loads immediately.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: `lazy` defers fetching the media until the element nears the viewport; it takes precedence over `preload`, and with `autoplay` it also delays playback. `eager` loads immediately.

attributes.name: disableremoteplayback
attributes.description: Stops the browser from offering remote playback (casting the media to another device) for this element.

attributes.name: disableremoteplayback
attributes.description: Stops the browser from offering remote playback (casting the media to another device) for this element.

attributes.name: disablepictureinpicture
attributes.description: Stops the browser from offering picture-in-picture for this video, including automatic picture-in-picture.

attributes.name: controlslist
attributes.description: Hides buttons in the browser's built-in media controls, as a space-separated list of `nodownload`, `nofullscreen` and `noremoteplayback`.

attributes.name: controlslist
attributes.description: Hides buttons in the browser's built-in media controls, as a space-separated list of `nodownload`, `nofullscreen` and `noremoteplayback`.

attributes.name: credentialless
attributes.description: Loads the iframe's document in a new, ephemeral context without the embedder's cookies or storage. Lets cross-origin-isolated pages embed third-party content that doesn't send CORP or COEP headers.

attributes.name: privateToken
attributes.description: JSON-encoded parameters for a Private State Token operation (such as a token redemption) to attach to the iframe's navigation request.

attributes.name: attributionsourceid
attributes.description: An 8-bit (0–255) source ID for Private Click Measurement. Used with `attributiondestination` to measure ad click conversions without cross-site tracking.

globalAttributes.name: writingsuggestions
globalAttributes.description: Whether the browser may offer writing suggestions, such as predictive inline text, while the user types in this editable element. `false` turns them off; `true` or an empty value turns them on. Descendants inherit the setting.

globalAttributes.name: elementtiming
globalAttributes.description: Marks an image or text element for the Element Timing API. When it renders, a `PerformanceElementTiming` entry with this identifier is reported to `PerformanceObserver`.

elements.name: camera
elements.description: A browser-rendered control that asks for camera access when the user activates it, then delivers a video track. Fires `track` on success, `cancel` if the user declines, and `error` on failure.

elements.name: microphone
elements.description: A browser-rendered control that asks for microphone access when the user activates it, then delivers an audio track. Fires `track` on success, `cancel` if the user declines, and `error` on failure.

elements.name: usermedia
elements.description: A browser-rendered control that asks for camera and microphone access when the user activates it, then delivers one `MediaStream` with both tracks. Fires `stream`, `cancel` or `error`.

elements.name: geolocation
elements.description: A browser-rendered button for getting the user's location. Clicking it shows the permission prompt; if the user allows it, the position is available on the element and a `location` event fires. Child content is fallback for browsers without support.

attributes.name: autolocate
attributes.description: If permission was already granted, get the location as soon as the element is attached, without waiting for a click.

attributes.name: watch
attributes.description: Keep reporting position changes, like `watchPosition()`, instead of reporting once.

elements.name: model
elements.description: Embeds an interactive 3D model rendered by the browser.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Address of the 3D model resource.

attributes.name: autoplay
attributes.description: Start the model's animation automatically once it has loaded.

attributes.name: loop
attributes.description: Repeat the model's animation.

attributes.name: stagemode
attributes.description: How user input affects the model: `none` (the default) leaves it in place; `orbit` lets the user rotate it by dragging.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Width of the element. The model is scaled to fit on first load.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height of the element. The model is scaled to fit on first load.
